description: This file defines the class EasyHandle, which models a cURL easy handle used internally by GuzzleHttp to manage HTTP requests and responses, including handling headers, responses, and related exceptions.

classes.name: EasyHandle
classes.description: Represents a cURL easy handle encapsulating the cURL resource, associated request/response data, headers, and related processing logic.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Constructs and attaches a Response object based on the received headers and data stored in the EasyHandle.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to handle property access, throws exceptions for invalid or released properties.
